'''Odionate Sith troopers''' were regular infantry who served in [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]]'s miltiary forces during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. They wore white armor with crimson stripes and their helmets resembled those later worn by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|Clone troopers]]. They were recruited from non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force sensitive]] sentient beings who were conscripted into the [[Odionate]] military. They were separate from other Odionate military units like the [[Thunder Guard]] and the [[Lightning Guard]]. They saw action during the various conflicts of the [[Second Charge Matrica]] including the [[Invasion of Sarrassia]] and the [[Massacre on Skarpos|Second Battle of Skarpos]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]].
